The issuer displays a solid liquidity profile with current assets ($1,536M) significantly exceeding current liabilities ($539M), positive net income ($644M), and a moderate leverage position (Total Liabilities to Assets of ~58.7% and Equity of $2,427M). However, the company faces substantial operational headwinds, highlighted by a severe operating loss (EBIT of -$988M), indicating that bottom-line profitability was likely driven by non-operating income or tax benefits rather than core operations. Balancing the healthy balance sheet and net profitability against severe core operational underperformance places the issuer in the lower investment-grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
